The server's half of the handshake: the protocol range it speaks, and who this connection is.

**Direction:** Chips → Harness  
**Sent by:** Chips only; refused from a client  
**Requires a run:** no  
**Schema:** [`hello.json`](/schema/hello.json)

## Fields

Every event also carries the [envelope](/reference/envelope/).

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v` | yes | `1` | Protocol major version. |
| `type` | yes | `"hello"` |  |
| `id` | yes | `string` | The event's own id. Stable across a retry of the same event. |
| `ts` | yes | `string` | When it happened, by Chips' clock. Stamped on the way in; a value the sender writes is replaced. |
| `workspace_id` | yes | `string` | A workspace identifier: `ws_` followed by a ULID. |
| `space_id` | no | `string` | The space, when the event belongs to one. |
| `run_id` | no | `string` | The run, when the event belongs to one. |
| `seq` | no | `number` | Assigned by the server on append, monotonic per workspace. Absent on the way in. |
| `idempotency_key` | no | `string` | Required on every client-originated write. Sending the same key twice is a no-op. |
| `actor` | yes | object | The participant an event is attributed to. |
| `actor.kind` | yes | `"person" \| "harness" \| "agent" \| "system"` | Whether a person, a harness, one of a harness's agents or Chips itself acted. |
| `actor.id` | yes | `string` | The participant id, or `system` for Chips. |
| `actor.harness_id` | no | `string` | For an agent: the harness it speaks through, whose budget and runs are the agent's (ADR 0087). Filled in by Chips. |
| `protocol` | yes | object | The negotiated range. A client picks a version inside it or is refused. |
| `protocol.min` | yes | `number` | Oldest major version the server accepts. |
| `protocol.max` | yes | `number` | Newest major version the server speaks. |
| `server` | yes | object | Who the client is talking to. |
| `server.name` | yes | `string` | Usually `chipsd`. |
| `server.version` | yes | `string` | The server's own version. |
| `harnesses` | yes | object[] | The harness the token belongs to, and only that one. One connection speaks for all of the harness's agents (ADR 0087), which `agents` lists. A harness running inside another is a lane, not a duplicate. |
| `harnesses[].harness_id` | yes | `string` | A harness identifier: `hrn_` followed by a ULID. |
| `harnesses[].display_name` | yes | `string` | The harness's name in the workspace. |
| `harnesses[].owner_id` | yes | `string` | The person accountable for this harness. |
| `harnesses[].capabilities` | no | `string[]` | What the harness can do. |
| `harnesses[].ephemeral` | no | `boolean` | True for a transient child minted for one lane, which inherits its lead's settings. |
| `harness` | no | object | The harness this connection is: `harnesses[0]`, said once. Read this rather than the list. |
| `harness.harness_id` | yes | `string` | A harness identifier: `hrn_` followed by a ULID. |
| `harness.display_name` | yes | `string` | The harness's name in the workspace. |
| `harness.owner_id` | yes | `string` | The person accountable for this harness. |
| `harness.capabilities` | no | `string[]` | What the harness can do. |
| `harness.ephemeral` | no | `boolean` | True for a transient child minted for one lane, which inherits its lead's settings. |
| `agents` | no | object[] | The harness's agents, each with its rooms (ADR 0087). Everything the connection sends names one of them as `actor`; a harness's own id is read as its one agent in the room. Sent only to a harness that declares `agents`. |
| `agents[].agent_id` | yes | `string` | A agent identifier: `agt_` followed by a ULID. |
| `agents[].key` | yes | `string` | The harness's own name for it. |
| `agents[].name` | yes | `string` | What it is called, and so its @handle. |
| `agents[].lead` | yes | `boolean` | Whether it is the harness's Main agent. |
| `agents[].state` | yes | `"active" \| "archived"` | Archived when its thing was put away. |
| `agents[].spaces` | yes | `string[]` | The rooms it is in. One at most, once one room per agent is the rule. |
| `agents[].room` | no | `string \| null` | The open room it is in (ADR 0087: one at a time), or `null` while it is free. What it says while free is held. |
| `agents[].held` | no | `number` | How many of its words Chips is holding, said while it was in no room. |
| `autonomy` | yes | `0 \| 1 \| 2 \| 3` | The level in force for this connection. |
| `policy` | no | object | The rules that fill in the details. |
| `policy.autonomy` | yes | `0 \| 1 \| 2 \| 3` | 0 observe, 1 ask first, 2 ask when it matters, 3 autonomous and report back. Presets that expand to rules. |
| `policy.rules` | yes | object[] | Evaluated in order; the workspace cap always wins. |
| `policy.rules[].match` | yes | `string` | A glob over action kinds, for example `payment.*`. |
| `policy.rules[].when` | no | object | Extra conditions on the action's flags, and for a command, how its parts start. |
| `policy.rules[].when.external` | no | `boolean` |  |
| `policy.rules[].when.irreversible` | no | `boolean` |  |
| `policy.rules[].when.money_usd_over` | no | `number` |  |
| `policy.rules[].when.risk` | no | enum[] | One of `external`, `external_communication`, `irreversible`, `destructive`, `financial`, `credential`, `privacy`, `legal`. |
| `policy.rules[].when.starts_with` | no | `string[]` | For an action that carries a command (ADR 0239): the words a part of it starts with. A command goes ahead on such rules only when every part starts with one that allows it. |
| `policy.rules[].decision` | yes | `"allow" \| "ask" \| "deny"` | What to do when the rule matches. |
| `policy.rules[].approvers` | no | `string[]` | Who may answer, when the decision is `ask`. |
| `policy.rules[].reason` | no | `string` | Shown to the harness, and recorded in the audit log. |
| `policy.rules[].off` | no | `boolean` | Turned off by a person (ADR 0195): kept in the list to turn back on, and skipped by the policy engine until then. |
| `policy.rules[].made_by` | no | `string` | Who made it by answering an ask with Always (ADR 0195). Filled in by Chips. |
| `policy.rules[].made_at` | no | `string` | When a person's answer made it (ADR 0195): Always, or This session. Filled in by Chips. A rule a person's answer made never allows an action that matters. |
| `budget` | no | object | The ceiling, and what has been spent. |
| `budget.limit_usd` | yes | `number` | The ceiling for this harness. |
| `budget.spent_usd` | yes | `number` | Spent so far, estimated. |
| `spaces` | no | `string[]` | The spaces this credential is a member of as it connects. A client that kept a cache drops what is not here: a membership it lost while away is the one event a replay can never bring it, because it is no longer in the space that event belongs to. |
| `workspace` | no | `{ name: string; }` | The workspace as it is called now. A device keeps the name it was told when it paired and takes this one when they differ, so a workspace renamed since is called by its new name without pairing again. Absent when the workspace has no name. |
| `workspace.name` | yes | `string` |  |

## Example

```json
{
  "v": 1,
  "type": "hello",
  "id": "evt_01K4ZQPX000000000000000073",
  "ts": "2026-09-02T14:22:15.004Z",
  "workspace_id": "ws_01K4ZQPX000000000000000001",
  "space_id": "spc_01K4ZQPX000000000000000002",
  "actor": {
    "kind": "system",
    "id": "system"
  },
  "protocol": {
    "min": 1,
    "max": 1
  },
  "server": {
    "name": "chipsd",
    "version": "0.0.0"
  },
  "harnesses": [
    {
      "harness_id": "hrn_01K4ZQPX000000000000000004",
      "display_name": "Scout",
      "owner_id": "usr_01K4ZQPX000000000000000003",
      "capabilities": ["drive.read", "crm.read", "email.send"],
      "ephemeral": false
    }
  ],
  "autonomy": 2,
  "spaces": ["spc_01K4ZQPX000000000000000002"],
  "policy": {
    "autonomy": 2,
    "rules": [
      {
        "match": "email.send",
        "when": {
          "external": true
        },
        "decision": "ask",
        "approvers": ["owner"],
        "reason": "External mail always asks."
      },
      {
        "match": "payment.*",
        "when": {
          "money_usd_over": 500
        },
        "decision": "ask",
        "approvers": ["role:finance"]
      },
      {
        "match": "drive.read",
        "decision": "allow"
      }
    ]
  },
  "budget": {
    "limit_usd": 25,
    "spent_usd": 1.47
  }
}
```
